title: Moesha
description:
S5 E1 — Good Vibrations?
A frustrated Moesha longs for a promotion from 'gopher' to writer at Vibe magazine but believes that her boss, Joe Scott, would rather she pay her dues with something other than her writing talent.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E2 — Fired Up
Eager to get on the fast track at Vibe Magazine, Moesha pretends to be a reporter to land a Maya Angelou interview.  But her ambition, coupled with Maya’s advice, leads Moesha down an entirely different path than she’d planned.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E3 — The Party’s Over (Here)
Unable to resist the temptations of college life, Moesha and Niecy become regulars on the party circuit, until their attendance at a late-night frat party takes its toll in more ways than one.

S1 E20 — Slam Dunked
Mary and Brenda cry foul when Sandra hooks up with a pro basketball player whose arrogant moves and behind-the-back 'passes' rub off on impressionable Calvin.

S1 E21 — Fifty Big Ones
Mary and Lester throw an extravagant bash for her parents' 50th wedding anniversary, only to find that the guests of honor aren't speaking to each other. Veteran performers Beah Richards and Whitman Mayo guest star as Mary's feuding parents.

S1 E22 — Pick Six
Mary gambles her relationship with Rose and Pearl when she belittles their passion for the lottery, but the odds of losing their friendship increase when Sandra spies Mary playing a hunch and buying her own ticket.

S5 E1 — The Fight Of The Century
The Jenkins hold their own championship bout when Lester forgets that he and Mary are supposed to go to the theater and she cancels the cable service right before the big fight.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S4 E4 — Clubbed
To compete against a successful new nightclub, Eddie offers to give away a luxury car.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S4 E5 — Worst Impressions
A therapist recommends some role reversal to help Malcolm and Eddie settle a disagreement about money.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:

Malcolm and Eddie enlist their friends to make a low budget horror film, ala The Blair Witch Project.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S4 E7 — Won't Power
Malcolm, Eddie and their friends bet on who can go the longest without sex.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S4 E8 — Wrongest Yard, The
Malcolm and Eddie are blamed for injuring of a popular professional football player.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S5 E3 — Bank On This
Fred and Lamont learn that banking can be harmful to your health when their loan application is interrupted by a robbery. The robbers search for a hostage to help their getaway and decide that Fred is just what they've been looking for.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S5 E4 — The Sanford Arms
As new landlords of an apartment house, Fred and Lamont have to be selective about their tenants. Fred seems to have found the perfect renters -- a hooker, a hippie, an ex-con and newlyweds.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S5 E5 — Steinberg And Son
Fred and Lamont are outraged when they see a new television series about a man, his son and their junk business. Although the TV family is obviously dissimilar, the Sanfords prepare to sue the network to protect their reputation.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S5 E6 — Brother Can You Spare An Act
The only way for Fred to get his white brother-in-law Rodney out of his house and his hair is to do something drastic -- like go into show business.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S5 E7 — Della, Della, Della
Working on a campaign for a political candidate, singer/actress Della Reese convinces Fred to let her use the Sanford home as campaign headquarters. It doesn't seem to matter to Fred that Lamont is supporting the other candidate.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S5 E8 — Donna Pops The Question
It's now or never for Fred when his girlfriend Donna receives a proposal from another man. She hands him an ultimatum that sends shock waves up and down his bachelor spine.
